# scenario-manifest.tsv — the curated scenario tier: which recorded example of the reference's own scenario specs becomes
# which kit scenario (input of convert-scenarios.py). Columns (tab-separated): kit_id, source example id (rspec id at the
# pin, or "authored" for a scenario written in kit form), title, rules, rbd, tags, options (JSON, see
# Re-mint: KIT_SCENARIO_RECORD_DIR=<dir> oracle.sh run -j 1 -r scenario-recorder.rb <the spec files below> (recorder v4:
#          authored rows: scenario-replay.py --scenarios <those files> --dump <d> (on the oracle), then
# Authored rows (2026-10-02): rules that no source example isolates — BE-SP-62 / RBD-59 (plan amount edit cancels a
#   pending downgrade), BE-SP-65 (charge selection on upgrade and termination), BE-SP-66 (fixed-charge selection on the
#   starting and the termination invoice); expectations come from the replay on the reference (evidence ref "derived").
# Rejected at curation (2026-10-02; reasons recorded so they are not retried blindly):
#   identical-filter examples (charge filters with empty values are refused over REST; equal creation instants tie),
#   invoice_numbering per-billing-entity (numbers depend on the finalization order of simultaneous drafts),
#   credit_note_rounding [1:4:1] (direct model update), invoices_spec [1:22:3] (noise request bodies, ambiguous draft binds), events_targeting_wallets and
#   wallet_traceability [1:1:4:1] (factory wallets / transaction priorities set on models), create_event_spec (factory
#   subscription), pay_in_advance_charges_spec (factory events), cascade_filters [1:8] (wall-clock seconds drift with recorder v3; may convert with v4),
#   wallets/topup_rule_with_limits (factory plan + wall clock), advance_charges (fees paid through model updates),
#   credit_note_spec [1:3:2:1] (metrics of another organization), several billing entities per customer set,
#   void_invoice_spec [1:3:1] (orders two credit notes created in one step by creation time: fails on the frozen kit clock).
